scenicChapters.title: Watchtowers WP 15/8 to 15/10 → Fort site of Burgsalach
scenicChapters.narrative: Slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did. Water arrives beside the road and stays for 39 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go.

places-fort-site-and-civil-settlement-of.story: 185 km from Neustadt an der Donau to Neustadt an der Donau, about 3 h 11 of riding. It goes by way of Watchtowers WP 15/8 to 15/10, Fort site of Burgsalach, fort site and civil settlement of Theilenh and back through Fort site of Burgsalach. It was put together for the scenery rather than the shortest line.
